annotations.title: Save a spot at an address

description: Saves a spot (a place that matters to the connected person, where Scout looks out for them) at an address they typed, with a kind: home, work, school, church, gym or other, and an optional name. The address must resolve to one confident, house-level match in their home city; when it does not, nothing is saved and the result lists the top suggestions with their lat and lon. Then ask the person which one they meant and call save_spot again with that suggestion's lat and lon (never coordinates from anywhere else). Ten spots per account; a spot already within a tenth of a mile is reported, not duplicated. Call this only when the person asks to save a place. Needs a connected account.

address.description: The street address or place name they typed.

kind.description: home, work, school, church, gym or other.

lat.description: Only from a suggestion this tool returned, to confirm it.

lon.description: Only from a suggestion this tool returned, to confirm it.

name.description: A nickname. Defaults to the kind (Home, Work, School, Church, Gym); required for other.

name: save_spot
